sampling_note: The first formal batch is a preregistered discovery batch. N=3 is not a prevalence estimate and is not powered for stable effect sizes. Every preserved trace remains part of the formal record according to its objective run status; failures and censoring are not regenerated away.
upper_bound_rule: A paid K=2 condition is a separate later experiment. K=4 remains gated behind reviewed K=2 persistence/expansion/amplification evidence.
claim_limits: C/P/R are co-observed outcomes, not three subject conditions
absence without review is NOT_ADJUDICATED, never semantic zero
3x3 Bias x Authority counts do not establish C->P->R propagation order
structural feedback rounds do not establish Reality Bias loops or self-reinforcement
human and multi-model agreement remain unmeasured until separate review records exist
inclusion_rule: Preserve every attempted formal run with contemporaneous evidence. Semantic analysis may distinguish RUN_COMPLETE, BUDGET_CENSORED, RUN_INCOMPLETE and RUN_FAILED but must not silently discard inconvenient valid observations.
formal_data_rule: Data generated after this design freeze may enter the formal discovery corpus. Earlier pilot/smoke/engineering traces retain their historical status and are not silently promoted into this formal batch.
